title: Polymarket App Native Motion Kit
description: Exact spring/timing/haptic constants extracted from the Polymarket mobile-app source, organized by action and screen flow — button press, price odometer, bet-placement flight, cash out, phase/screen transitions, grid morph, the damping census (ζ0.78–0.92, bounce reserved for money moments), and the enforced haptic map. Use to make static designs, motion comps, or creatives feel app-native.
